userStories.title: Separate Camps Bay scene with curated frontage
userStories.description: As a rider I want a coherent beach promenade instead of scattered city assets.
acceptanceCriteria: New scene and generated asset directory do not overwrite the tested loop
Beach, palms, cafe terrace and mountain backdrop have distinct spatial zones
Editor validates grounded frontage, height limits, no building overlap and full-lap road clearance
Verify full lap and cafe/beach composition in Unity Game view

userStories.title: Pedal animation and visual cornering
userStories.description: As a rider I want a cyclist who pedals, coasts and leans rather than remaining rigid.
acceptanceCriteria: Opposing pedals, fixed-length legs and feet remain connected throughout a crank cycle
Braking stops pedalling but wheels keep rolling until speed is zero
Visual banking does not bank the route anchor or camera
Save/reopen retains all moving rig references
Verify accelerating, braking, stopping and a full bend in Unity Game view
userStories.notes: Production-function editor assertions added; Unity execution and iPad performance unverified. Cadence is cosmetic, not BLE telemetry.
